source: Original 16 portraits: user-supplied phone screenshot crops, temporarily approved, not original high-resolution art. New special templates: AI-generated grayscale creature portraits with deterministic elemental palettes; staged catalogue, not complete or phone-approved.

special_catalog.note: All 31 unique special silhouettes (types 2-32) prepared in four elemental-v1 palettes; Lich32 now has its own portrait. Original crops, previous special artwork and mechanics preserved. Art catalogue coverage complete; not a claim of final visual acceptance or full original-game parity.
